title: Sliding Tiles
description: The classic sliding puzzle. Slide the numbered tiles into order using the one empty space. Choose 3×3, 4×4 or 5×5 and beat your best number of moves.
instructions: Click or tap a tile next to the empty space to slide it.
Keyboard: arrow keys or WASD slide a tile into the gap.
Put the numbers in order from 1 at the top-left.
Change the board size with the size button.
